narrative.introduction: The Legume Ontology catalogs canonical culinary legumes, pulses, beans, peas, lentils, chickpeas, and legume-derived ingredients used worldwide in cooking. This domain models culinary ingredients, not botanical taxonomy, prepared meals, snack products, or beverages.
narrative.seo_description: Explore canonical culinary legumes and pulses by group — usage intensity, identity, and pairing metadata in the PairingMethod Food Ontology.
narrative.summary: Canonical culinary legumes across six immutable groups: Beans, Peas, Lentils, Chickpeas, Other Legumes, and Legume Products.
